Are you passionate about #AI and #cybersecurity? Do you love working with high profile teams with a sure taste of challenge and variety? You dream of joining a fast-growing company with start-up mentality? Eager to learn continuously and drive innovation via AI while securing the digital world of our customers? Join Proximus Ada!

Proximus Ada is the first Belgian center of excellence combining artificial intelligence and cybersecurity. Our mission is to be the leader applying state-of-the-art technology to drive transformation through AI & Cybersecurity Solutions for the Proximus Group and its partners.

Role description

As B2B AI Translator you will help customers unlock business value through AI. Acting as the bridge between business stakeholders and AI delivery teams, you translate business challenges into impactful AI solutions. You identify opportunities, build business cases, and guide initiatives from ideation to implementation. Working closely with customers, sales teams, domain experts, data scientists, AI engineers, and solution architects, you ensure AI projects address real business needs and deliver measurable results. The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, excellent communication skills, and a solid understanding of AI technologies and their business applications.

Key responsibilities

In your role as an AI Translator, your responsibilities will cover:

• Strategic Visionary (30%): Support stakeholders in their AI transformation by helping define long-term visions and short-term priorities. You will design roadmaps, identify and prioritize use cases based on business value, and advise on AI governance and process redesign. Daily activities include engaging with clients to understand their strategic objectives, translating success stories into compelling material, and acting as a trusted advisor on AI capabilities, risks, and opportunities.
• Project Orchestrator (60%): Lead the execution of AI initiatives, acting as the bridge between business experts and AI engineers. You will oversee data maturation, pilot projects with MVPs, and ensure solutions deliver value and operational excellence. Your daily tasks involve facilitating workshops, translating business needs into technical specifications, collaborating with technical teams, monitoring project KPIs, and ensuring AI adoption in production.
• Innovative Thinker (10%): Contribute to the team’s evolution by exploring new methodologies, technologies, and industry trends. This includes staying informed about the AI market, driving innovation, and introducing fresh ideas or best practices to improve our approach and solutions.

Profile

• You own a master’s degree in business engineering, computer science, data science, economics, or a related field.
• You have 3-5 years of experience in translating business needs into technology-driven solutions.
• You have a customer-centric mindset with a passion for solving business problems, excellence and innovation.
• You enjoy being at the forefront of change, questioning the way things are done, rethinking processes and have a natural curiosity, picking up new information quickly.
• Experience in B2B environments and consulting roles is a big plus.
Tech skills

• You have a great interest in all domains of AI (Gen AI, Agentic AI, Classical AI) and deep understanding of its possibilities & limitations.
• You possess a sharp, analytical mind with a foundation in statistics.
• You are familiar with AI platforms and ecosystems such as Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Databricks, or similar technologies.
• You understand the fundamentals of data, including data quality, governance and analytics.
• You have experience creating business cases, value assessments, and ROI analyses for technology initiatives.
• You master PowerPoint and can prepare inspiring & convincing executive presentations, solution proposals, and customer-facing documentation.
• Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI principles, and relevant regulations (e.g., EU AI Act) is a big plus.
Soft skills

• You excel in communication, storytelling and you can explain complex AI concepts to non-technical audience, both in writing and speaking.
• You can motivate and inspire others, and you're skilled at fostering collaboration across functional teams without direct authority and taking the lead on new projects.
• You have strong facilitation and workshop management capabilities.
• You have a strategic thinking mindset combined with pragmatism and execution focus.
• You work well independently and like to take initiative.
• You're equally comfortable communicating with top-level management and experts, and you know how to build a network of support.
• You are at ease with uncertainty, ambiguity and fast-evolving environments.
• You are a native Dutch speaker and fluent in English (mandatory). Being trilingual is a big plus

Turn business questions and data into practical AI solutions. As a Junior AI Engineer, you will combine data analysis, machine learning and modern AI engineering to generate reliable business insights and build scalable applications. You will work with business and domain experts to understand their needs, explore and validate data, communicate clear recommendations, and help translate promising ideas into production-ready solutions.

The role has three complementary pillars: Data Analysis & Business Insights, Machine Learning & Generative AI, and Software & Cloud Engineering. You will receive guidance while progressively taking ownership of analytical, development, testing, deployment and documentation activities.
1. Data Analysis & Business Insights
• Use SQL and Python to explore, combine, clean, filter and validate data and answer business questions in a reliable, repeatable way.
• Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, correlations, anomalies and data-quality issues.
• Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches, hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
• Apply statistical methods and effective visualizations to validate findings and communicate them clearly.
• Independently investigate unfamiliar datasets, ask the right questions and select an appropriate analytical or machine-learning approach.
• Explain evidence, model drivers, reliability, assumptions, limitations and potential bias to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Produce concise analytical notes that document conclusions, limitations and actionable recommendations.
• Work closely with domain experts to gather context, respectfully challenge assumptions, validate conclusions and document decisions.2. Machine Learning & Generative AI
• Build, test and explain practical machine-learning solutions, including regression, classification, clustering and similarity analysis.
• Use anomaly-detection and forecasting techniques to identify unusual patterns and estimate future outcomes.
• Contribute to Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions and basic agentic workflows.
• Assess the quality and suitability of AI outputs using appropriate evaluation methods and business criteria.
• Prototype and validate AI solutions with business stakeholders before further industrialization.3. Software & Cloud Engineering
• Develop maintainable Python components and contribute to reliable AI applications.
• Contribute to deploying, monitoring and maintaining AI solutions in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure.
• Apply software-engineering, DevOps and MLOps practices, including Git, testing, CI/CD and reproducible experimentation.
• Collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers and business experts throughout the solution lifecycle.
• Create clear technical documentation and contribute to team knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Your profile:
• Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Up to 2 years of relevant professional experience. Internships, academic projects and personal AI or data projects are valued.
• Good foundation in Python and common data-analysis or machine-learning libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn.
• Working knowledge of SQL and experience analysing structured datasets.
• Understanding of statistics, data validation, machine learning and effective data visualization.
• Strong interest in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and modern AI architectures.
• Ability to connect analytical findings to business questions and communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.Technologies you may work with
• Python, SQL, pandas, scikit-learn and data-visualization libraries.
• LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen or CrewAI.
• Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Search, vector databases, graph databases and knowledge graphs.
• Databricks, including catalogue structures and AI/ML capabilities.
• Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines and MLflow.What will help you succeed
• Business curiosity: you seek to understand the underlying business question before selecting a technical approach.
• Critical thinking: you check assumptions, explore alternative explanations and validate conclusions against evidence.
• Problem solving: you can structure ambiguous problems and learn unfamiliar technologies or datasets quickly.
• Collaboration: you work constructively with engineering, data and business colleagues.
• Communication: you document your work clearly and adapt explanations to the audience.
• Quality and ownership: you test your work, pay attention to detail, ask for support when needed and follow through on commitments.
You do not need to master every technology listed above. We are looking for strong analytical and technical fundamentals, hands-on curiosity and the ability to learn and grow in a supportive team environment.

Three boxes to tick: product ownership, partner-driven platforms, and modernising a legacy core without breaking the service.

Product Owner – Registration & Domain Lifecycle | Brussels

Our client is a European, technology-driven organisation that operates a registration platform its partners rely on every single day.

Its product is a lifecycle: a name is registered, renewed, transferred, suspended or released, millions of times over, through a network of accredited partners and under rules it does not set alone.

That platform is now being modernised, moving from a legacy core towards the next generation of registration services, without a single interruption to the service partners depend on.

To drive this, the organisation is looking for a Product Owner to own the vision, the roadmap and the backlog of this platform.

 

The job

• Own the vision, roadmap and backlog of the registration platform and of the lifecycle capabilities built on top of it.
• Translate partner needs, operational realities and regulatory obligations into clear product direction, and make transparent trade-offs between value, urgency, risk and delivery capacity.
 
Role
• Define and maintain the roadmap across the core registration platform, registration APIs, domain-name lifecycle and data analytics capabilities.
• Own and structure the backlog, balancing immediate service improvements against modernisation, resilience and long-term sustainability.
• Give clear product direction to the Business Analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Work closely with Business Owners and with the engineering, architecture, service delivery, compliance and security teams to keep requirements understood, feasible and aligned.
• Track adoption, usability and service quality, and turn what the numbers show into roadmap decisions.
Profile
• 7+ years in technology-driven products or services, with real ownership as a Product Owner or Product Manager.
• Domain-name ecosystem knowledge (EPP, WHOIS/RDAP, DNS) is a big plus; experience on regulated, partner-driven platforms — telecom, payments, utilities — works just as well.
• You know how to modernise a legacy core without disrupting daily service.
• Excellent written and spoken English.

As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X) in the Nuclear Pressure Equipment Team, you will join a dynamic team that works every day for our customers and, in doing so, helps create a safer and more efficient society. Vinçotte is active with various types of customers. We have developed our expertise and organization in both public and residential buildings, and we are highly entrepreneurial in the energy sector, including nuclear activities. In addition, we are highly innovative for customers in the (petro)chemical and pharmaceutical sectors, production environments, and the transport and logistics sector. With more than 60,000 satisfied customers, we demonstrate that the combination of our expertise, guidance, and technology makes all the difference. As a 
Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers.
